vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: web-collection
Version: 1.1.3

This skill bundle automates data collection from social media platforms via a local bridge API and browser extension. It contains high-risk execution patterns: `scripts/collect_and_export_loop.sh` executes arbitrary shell commands provided via the `--bridge-cmd` argument using `bash -lc`, and `scripts/run.sh` supports remote command execution via SSH. While these features are functionally aligned with managing a scraping infrastructure, they present a significant RCE (Remote Code Execution) risk if the agent is prompted to run untrusted commands. The scripts also contain hardcoded local developer paths (e.g., `/Users/zhym/...`) and rely on an external 'meixi-connector' bridge whose source is not provided.

llm.summary: The skill's code, scripts, and instructions align with its stated purpose of collecting data via a local browser-extension bridge; nothing requested is disproportionate to that goal.

dimensions.detail: Name/description describe a local bridge-driven browser-extension collector for Douyin/TikTok/Xiaohongshu. The included scripts implement exactly that: POST /api/collect, poll /api/tasks/<id>, optional export and bridge auto-start. Required binaries (curl, node) match the implementation.

dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and scripts instruct running local scripts that interact with a local HTTP bridge and a Chrome extension. They also include an explicit remote-run path via SSH and optional env vars for bridge URL/command. The instructions do not ask for unrelated system files or credentials, but they do instruct executing a user-supplied --bridge-cmd and optionally ssh to a remote host, which grants the ability to run arbitrary commands if those parameters are set.

The runtime uses optional env vars (e.g., WEB_COLLECTION_REMOTE_SSH, WEB_COLLECTION_BRIDGE_CMD, WEB_COLLECTION_BRIDGE_URL) referenced by run.sh; these are not mandatory and are reasonable for remote/bridge configuration. There is no unexpected request for unrelated secrets.

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it claims: it talks to a local bridge (default http://127.0.0.1:19820) and expects a Chrome extension to be installed. Before running, verify the bridge start command (the --bridge-cmd argument or WEB_COLLECTION_BRIDGE_CMD) so you know exactly what process will be launched — that argument can run arbitrary commands. Also be cautious with the optional WEB_COLLECTION_REMOTE_SSH setting: if set, the skill will SSH to the remote host and execute the collector there. Only enable remote SSH or pass a bridge-cmd you trust, and ensure the browser extension and any configured export targets (e.g., Feishu) are trusted and configured intentionally.
